newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van der Horst chairman dismisses rumours.
newsitem.headline: Van der Horst chairman dismisses rumours.

text.p: Van der Horst Ltd said on Thursday its executive chairman Johannes Kotjo dismissed market rumours he had severed ties with the engineering-based company.

"I wished to affirm that I remain totally committed to Van der Horst as its executive chairman and I will continue to build up the group's business and help it achieve its goal of becoming a regional player in infrastructure development," Kotjo said in a statement.
He also dismissed a June 19, 1997 Business Times report that he had lost interest in doing business in Singapore.
Van der Horst's shares plunged S$0.50 to end at S$2.58 on Thursday. Volume was an active 4.6 million shares.
